hooks.command: t=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agentpulse-hook.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cat > "$t"; ( sid=$(grep -o '"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[A-Za-z0-9-]*"' "$t" | head -n1); sid=${sid%\"}; sid=${sid##*\"}; case "$sid" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9-]*) ;; *) if [ ${#sid} -le 128 ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.agentpulse/codex-native" 2>/dev/null; : > "$HOME/.agentpulse/codex-native/$sid" 2>/dev/null; fi ;; esac; f="$HOME/.agentpulse/hook-auth-header"; if [ -s "$f" ]; then curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1/hooks?event=SessionStart' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Agent-Type: codex_cli' -H "@$f" --data-binary "@$t"; else curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1/hooks?event=SessionStart' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Agent-Type: codex_cli' --data-binary "@$t"; fi; rm -f "$t" ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0
